CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_MembresiasListadoItem_ObtenerMembresias]
@SearchText AS VARCHAR(100) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
	--OBTIENE LAS MEMBRESIAS VIGENTES

	IF(@SearchText IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @SearchText = ''
	END

	SELECT 
		mem.Id,
		mem.ClaveMembresia,
		info.NombreFiscal,
		info.RazonSocial
	FROM [dbo].[Membresia] mem
	LEFT JOIN [dbo].[InformacionFacturacion] info
		ON mem.InformacionFacturacion_Id = info.Id		
	WHERE 
		mem.Activo = 1
		AND mem.EstatusMembresia_Id = 1
		AND ((info.RazonSocial like '%'+@SearchText+'%') OR
			(info.NombreFiscal like '%'+@SearchText+'%') OR
			(mem.ClaveMembresia like '%'+@SearchText+'%') OR
			(@SearchText=''))
	
	ORDER BY info.RazonSocial ASC

END
Name: rpt_MembresiasListadoItem_ObtenerMembresias
